questions.prompt: Great in this war was the general Pompey.
questions.answer: Magnus in hōc bellō dux Pompeius fuit.

questions.prompt: No other route through the narrow valley have we.
questions.answer: Aliud iter per angustam vallem habēmus nūllum.

questions.prompt: Famous throughout Italy was that noble poet.
questions.answer: Celeber per tōtam Italiam ille nōbilis poēta erat.

questions.prompt: A weak old man the tyrant greatly feared.
questions.answer: Dēbilem senem tyrannus magnopere timēbat.

questions.prompt: Hidden in the deep woods lay the sacred altar.
questions.answer: Occulta in altīs silvīs iacēbat sacra āra.

questions.prompt: The city the Romans besieged for many years.
questions.answer: Urbem Rōmānī multōs annōs obsēdērunt.

questions.prompt: Swift is the messenger who brings good news.
questions.answer: Celer est nūntius quī bona nūntiat.

questions.prompt: Nothing the greedy king gave to the poor.
questions.answer: Nihil avārus rēx pauperibus dedit.

questions.prompt: The gods the pious farmer worshipped with offerings.
questions.answer: Deōs pius agricola dōnīs colēbat.

questions.prompt: Bright shone the stars above the silent camp.
questions.answer: Clāra fulgēbant sīdera super tacita castra.

questions.prompt: Long was the road that led down to the sea.
questions.answer: Longa erat via quae ad mare ferēbat.

questions.prompt: Praise the soldiers gave to their fearless leader.
questions.answer: Laudem mīlitēs intrepidō ducī dedērunt.

questions.prompt: Cruel was the master toward his exhausted captives.
questions.answer: Crūdēlis erat dominus in fessōs captīvōs.

questions.prompt: Sacred to the gods was that ancient grove.
questions.answer: Sacer deīs erat ille antīquus lūcus.

questions.prompt: Gold the merchant sought across dangerous seas.
questions.answer: Aurum mercātor per perīculōsa maria petēbat.

questions.prompt: Peace above all things the weary citizens desired.
questions.answer: Pācem fessī cīvēs super omnia cupiēbant.

questions.prompt: Wine the guests drank at the lavish feast.
questions.answer: Vīnum convīvae in lautō convīviō bibēbant.

questions.prompt: Noble was the death that the brave consul chose.
questions.answer: Nōbilis erat mors quam fortis cōnsul ēlēgit.

questions.prompt: The temples the conquering army utterly destroyed.
questions.answer: Templa victor exercitus penitus dēlēvit.

questions.prompt: It is the duty of a great man to punish the guilty.
questions.answer: Est virī māgnī pūnīre sontis.

questions.prompt: But I am SPEAKING NOW of common friendships.
questions.answer: Loquor autem dē commūnibus amīcitiīs.

questions.prompt: WHAT fellow-citizens we have LOST, have been stricken down by the violence of war.
questions.answer: Quōs āmīsimus cīvīs, eōs Mārtis vīs perculit.

questions.prompt: ABUNDANCE of MATTER produces COPIOUSNESS of EXPRESSION.
questions.answer: Rērum cōpia verbōrum cōpiam gignit.
